target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md
focus: degraded-sidecar receipt recovery and restart behavior
summary: ACL/key negative cases, fresh per-case key rules, same-account threat boundary, degraded receipt recovery, retention, and one-use tool permits are well specified. Two new documentation gaps remain: the loopback mutating harness has no explicit CSRF/token transport/Origin contract, and ordinary trace_id logging is not distinguished from decision_id despite a raw decision-ID exclusion.

findings.title: Loopback harness CSRF/authentication contract is missing
findings.evidence: §5/§6 specify a loopback browser harness, mutating Start/receipt routes and a random fixture token, but not its credential transport, Host/Origin verification, CORS behavior, or rejection of simple cross-origin form requests.
findings.risk: A hostile web origin may attempt to drive or probe a write-capable local harness; binding to loopback alone is not a complete browser CSRF contract.
findings.required_revision: Specify a non-cookie custom authorization header; exact Host and permitted Origin or equivalent per-case CSRF nonce/custom-header checks; reject cross-origin/opaque origins and unsupported/simple form content types; disable CORS sharing; prohibit mutation via GET; keep tokens out of logs and caller control; add negative browser cases.

findings.title: Ordinary trace_id logging is ambiguous against decision-ID redaction
findings.evidence: §3/§4 associate decision_id with Registry trace ID and exclude raw decision IDs from ordinary logs, while §7 lists trace_id in the ordinary log schema without defining whether it is distinct.
findings.risk: If trace_id equals decision_id, raw decision ID leaks into ordinary logs; if distinct, undocumented derivation may still permit correlation.
findings.required_revision: Define log trace_id as a fresh opaque request-level identifier unrelated to decision/task/lesson/user IDs, or log a keyed digest; prohibit mapping it to decision_id outside DB receipt/audit and add it to redaction assertions.

control_dispositions.same_account_threat_boundary: explicit; compromise by trusted account/admin/kernel/host out of scope
control_dispositions.degraded_receipt_recovery: authorized identical receipt replay and case-wide quarantine across restart specified; no-receipt or unavailable lookup fails closed
control_dispositions.one_use_tool_permit: specified; durable intent precedes one execution and invalid/reused permit rejected

remaining_conditions: Close PSK-SEC10-01 before approving the browser harness security contract.
Resolve PSK-SEC10-02 before approving the log privacy contract.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No browser-origin checks, filesystem permissions, key generation, build artifacts, database, or recovery flow were inspected at runtime.
This review does not approve implementation, production deployment, real student data, or classroom readiness.
